// Hammersley low-discrepancy scattering: point i has first coordinate i/Count
// and second the radical inverse of i in Base (typically 2). Requires Count
// to be fixed in advance; even better distributed than Halton
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Low-discrepancy_sequence).
type HammersleyPattern2D
    implements IValue
{
    Region: Bounds2D;
    Count: Integer;
    Base: Integer;
}
